# Apache POI

Test documents of Apache POI (<https://github.com/apache/poi>), copied unmodified under the Apache License 2.0:
`LICENSE` beside them is its text and `NOTICE` Apache POI's notice file, which section 4(d) of the licence asks a
redistribution to carry. Each document's git blob is the one at the path below in apache/poi at commit
07f1631dd66f647aacf2f43e3f408fe033aac4d0, so `git hash-object <document>` proves the copy.
